$comment: FX4 music library (D411, plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-clip-music-name-transitions.md 3.4; user 2026-11-20 chose 'find, generate and pick musics based on game clips'). Tracks come from the user's own music folder (Settings > Clips > Clip look > Music); nothing is downloaded. Each track is analysed once, off air, with PyAV + numpy (shipped Python runtime): tempo and beat grid (onset envelope + autocorrelation), energy curve, the drop (largest sustained energy rise), integrated loudness (BS.1770, scene_music.measure_lufs), brightness, and a mood guessed from them (the user may change it). Each reel's target (energy from its kills and streaks, moods from its kind) picks a track: seeded, weighted by score, never one of the last historyN tracks while another fits. Read by services/clip/music_library.py. All numbers are the agent's proposal; the mood guess is UNVERIFIED against real tracks.

fades.$comment: D437 (user 2026-11-22: the start fade-out and the end fade-in were too abrupt). Defaults for Settings > Clips (clips.look.music fadeInSec, fadeOutSec, fadeCurve). Curve s-curve: Audacity's manual (manual.audacityteam.org/man/adjustable_fade.html) says it gives a smoother, more musical fade than linear; 1.5 s is inside the usual 1-2 s music fade. introFadeOutSec and outroFadeInSec above are no longer used for folder, pack and AI tracks.

level.$comment: D437: measured 2026-11-22 on 11 reels the app made that day (docs/evidence/2026-11-22-reel-music-level-fades.md): the game mix where no music plays was -27 to -38 LUFS, the music at -16 LUFS was 11 to 22 LU louder than the game. Music under a foreground sound is usually set well under it (sources in D437), so the music now plays underGameDb under this reel's own game mix (measured before the render), and never louder than the user's level (clips.look.music.levelDb). No game measurement: the user's level alone.

voice.$comment: D437: the music goes depthDb lower while someone speaks in the game audio. Speech times come from Silero VAD (the onnx model shipped inside faster-whisper, already in the runtime; CPU, no download). attack/release in the 150-300 ms range the user asked for. Any failure: no extra duck, the render goes on with the game duck alone.

pack.$comment: FX5 (D427): the free music pack from Settings > Downloads (data/downloads/music-pack.json, item music-pack). A track counts only when it is in that manifest, in the pack folder and in the download's marker; its credit comes from the manifest.
